positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Agilis is a technology company focused on driving digitalization of commerce processes in the chemical industry. With Agilis, global chemical producers and distributors can launch their own cloud-based branded e-commerce portals, fully optimized and equipped with modern marketing tools and analytics. Agilis offers chemical suppliers an easy and cost-effective way to attract and engage customers via secure digital sales and marketing channels. Headquartered in Short Hills, NJ, with its growing technology team based in New York City, Agilis combines industry experience and technology expertise in building advanced, scalable technology solutions. For more information about Agilis, please visit https://agilischemicals.com.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Thunderbird is an open-source and cross-platform desktop application for email, chat, calendar, contacts, etc.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Open Tech Strategies provides expert advice and services to help organizations use the advantages of open source to reach their goals.  My work for them includes full stack web development  (Java, Python, JavaScript), with a focus on the front end, and also technical writing and editing.  For most of 2018 I worked with them on the Provider Screening Module (PSM) an open-source software development project in the public healthcare sector (i.e. Medicare, Medicaid).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Solution Guidance Corporation helps clients achieve mission success via technology enabled service solutions, which are delivered by empowered entrepreneurial professionals.
